answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock: each new agent locks 60 POA to earn. In 10 epochs the network records timing, task mix and counterparties in a fingerprint in sable ink, a signature no two share. One that mirrors another above 90% stays locked, earns nothing. Forging 1,000 clones costs 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 POA frozen, plus 1,000 fake traces. An honest agent pays once, passes probation, unlocks its deposit, earns undiluted; its saffron badge turns green.
